scope: Four real train QA / four groups / twenty pairs, two validation QA; mechanics only, not benchmark accuracy

training.objective: Each annotated positive section forms a listwise group with up to four nongold same-story negatives; cross-entropy selects the positive. All annotated positives participate, so multi-section questions contribute more training groups; report counts.
training.negatives: First three nongold BM25-ranked sections, then one seeded random remaining nongold section; no other gold-linked section can be a negative. If fewer negatives exist use those available. Questions with no nongold section yield no ranking group and are counted.
training.truncation: Question-section pair capped at 384 tokens; section annotation does not prove the retained prefix contains every relevant sentence. Report truncation counts.

warnings: Unused Gradio/Diffusers dependency conflicts and CPU no-triton warning; no missing/uninitialized model parameters.
